newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal may decide on Tabaqueira sale next week.
newsitem.headline: Portugal may decide on Tabaqueira sale next week.

text.p: The government could decide next week who has been designated to buy state owned tobacco company Tabaqueira.
"There will probably be a decision on Tabaqueira next week," a finance ministry source told Reuters.

The privatisation of Tabaqueira was discussed by Portuguese and Spanish officials at a two-day summit of the Portuguese and Spanish prime ministers in the Azores, but no decisions were taken, officials said.
"The Portuguese government is still studying the sale," the source said.
The presiding jury said it favoured the bid by PMM-SGPS, a holding company that includes U.S. tobacco company Philip Morris and the Portuguese Jorge de Mello group.
The other bidders are French group Seita and a group comprising Spain's Tabacalera and Portuguese tobacco company Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos.
The winner will be chosen by the Portuguese cabinet, based on the report submitted by the jury.
